topic: Sperm whales: deep divers with giant brains
script: Sperm whales can dive more than 2,000 meters deep to hunt squid. They can hold their breath for over an hour. They have the largest brain of any animal, weighing around 8 kilograms. Their clicks are among the loudest sounds made by any animal. They sometimes sleep floating upright in the water, like giant logs. Follow Pixel Abyss for more strange facts from the deep.
